svg.aria-label: Symptomatic bradycardia with hypotension: atropine 1 mg, repeat to a maximum of 3 mg, then transcutaneous pacing, dopamine or epinephrine. AV block strips: Mobitz I, PR lengthens until a beat drops; Mobitz II, fixed PR with sudden dropped beats; complete block, P waves and QRS unrelated. Mobitz II and complete block need pacemakers.

tspan.tspan: Mobitz I: longer, longer, longer, drop
Mobitz II: fixed PR, sudden drop
